I've planned Phase 2 (Playable page) as three plans in two waves. The tool's plan check passes with no issues and no blockers came up.

| Wave | Plan | Persona | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 02-01 Canvas renderer | engineering-frontend-developer | `src/render.js`: arena sizing, colours, drawing, plus `tests/render.test.js` |
| 1 | 02-02 Session state machine | engineering-senior-developer | `src/session.js`: a game-flow module with no DOM access, driven by timestamps (waiting, running at 15 ticks/s, paused, 1 s round-end hold, match over, test-hook mode), plus `tests/session.test.js` |
| 2 | 02-03 Page wiring and Playwright run | engineering-frontend-developer | `src/main.js` (frame loop, keys, `#score` and `#message`), `index.html` (`aria-live`, 792×600 canvas), and `tests/play.test.js` |

`tests/play.test.js` plays the game in Chromium. It checks start, steering, pause, round end, match end and restart. It also checks that the arena fits a 1024×768 window with cells of at least 8 px, reads pixel colours from the canvas, and confirms there are no requests to other origins. The coder will also look at a saved screenshot.

**Main decisions written into the plans:**
- **Test-hook safety:** `window.tron.reset()` cancels all real-time ticking and any pending round-end timer, so the game loop can't interfere with Playwright's `step()` calls.
- **Score:** recomputed from the game state every frame, so it changes on the tick a round ends.
- **Colours:** P1 `#00e5ff` with a lighter head `#b3f7ff`, P2 `#ff8c00` with head `#ffc680`, border and obstacles `#666`, crashed heads white. All are in one exported constant.
- **Layout:** 12 px cells on a 792×600 canvas for the default 64×48 arena.

**Pipeline summary (`--auto`):**

| Step | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Board assessment | Ran | All five members rejected only because Phase 2 isn't built yet. I kept their concrete advice as constraints (no loop vs. test-hook race, one colour constant, pixel-sampling check, `aria-live`). |
| Domain, spec, proposals | Skipped | Gates are off and no spec was triggered. |
| Decomposition | 3 plans, 2 waves | Plans in the same wave share no files. |
| Plan critique | PASS | I fixed one gap myself. Plan 02-02's test asked for 15 ticks from a single update call, but each call is capped at 5 ticks and the head-on meeting point was too close. It now steps in 16 ms frames and steers P2 away. |
| Security scan | No blockers | 0 secrets and no CRITICAL findings. The HIGH "no lockfile" flag is a false positive because the project has no dependencies. The OWASP/STRIDE review of the new files will happen when the phase is reviewed. |
| GitHub | Not tracked | The setting is "prompt" and gates are off, so I took "No". |

Remaining CAUTION: none.
